description: Scan the B. subtilis ara operon for AraR operator consensus matches, asking whether araM has its own operator
code:
import requests, re, numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
S=requests.Session(); S.headers.update({"User-Agent":"ra/1.0"})
start,end=2937500,2950600
url=("https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/efetch.fcgi?db=nuccore&id=NC_000964.3"
     f"&rettype=fasta&retmode=text&seq_start={start}&seq_stop={end}")
txt=S.get(url,timeout=90).text
seq="".join(l.strip() for l in txt.split("\n")[1:]).upper()
print("fetched", len(seq), "bp; header:", txt.split("\n")[0][:90])

CONS="ATTTGTACGTACAAAT"   # 16-bp palindromic AraR consensus, half-site ATTTGTAC (Mota 1999, PMID 10417639)
def rc(s): return s[::-1].translate(str.maketrans("ACGT","TGCA"))
L=len(CONS)
hits=[]
for i in range(len(seq)-L+1):
    w=seq[i:i+L]
    if "N" in w: continue
    m=sum(a==b for a,b in zip(w,CONS))
    m2=sum(a==b for a,b in zip(rc(w),CONS))
    best=max(m,m2)
    if best>=12: hits.append((start+i, w, best))
hits.sort(key=lambda x:-x[2])
genes=[("abfA",2938330,2939832),("araQ",2939851,2940696),("araP",2940697,2941638),("araN",2941674,2942975),
       ("araM",2943006,2944190),("araL",2944187,2945005),("araD",2944983,2945672),("araB",2945689,2947371),
       ("araA",2947385,2948875),("abnA",2949053,2950024)]
def locate(p):
    for n,a,b in genes:
        if a<=p<=b: return "inside "+n
    # intergenic
    for (n1,a1,b1),(n2,a2,b2) in zip(genes[:-1],genes[1:]):
        if b1<p<a2: return f"intergenic {n1}/{n2}"
    return "outside operon"
print("\n=== 16-bp matches to the AraR consensus ATTTGTACGTACAAAT (>=12/16 identities) ===")
tab=[]
for p,w,m in hits:
    tab.append(dict(position=p, match=m, seq=w, location=locate(p), dist_to_araA_start=p-2948875))
T=pd.DataFrame(tab); print(T.to_string(index=False))
T.to_csv("arar_operator_scan.csv",index=False)
print("\nHits in the araL/araM or araM/araN junctions:", (T.location.str.contains("araL/araM|araM/araN")).sum())
print("Best match anywhere inside araL, araM or araN coding sequence:",
      T[T.location.isin(["inside araL","inside araM","inside araN"])].match.max() if len(T[T.location.isin(["inside araL","inside araM","inside araN"])]) else "none >=12")

# profile plot
scores=np.array([max(sum(a==b for a,b in zip(seq[i:i+L],CONS)), sum(a==b for a,b in zip(rc(seq[i:i+L]),CONS))) for i in range(len(seq)-L+1)])
pos=np.arange(len(scores))+start
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(13,4))
ax.plot(pos,scores,lw=0.5,color="#444")
ax.axhline(12,color="red",ls="--",lw=1)
for n,a,b in genes:
    ax.axvspan(a,b,color="#2f6f9f" if n!="araM" else "#d14", alpha=0.25)
    ax.text((a+b)/2, 17.2, n, ha="center", fontsize=8, rotation=90 if (b-a)<900 else 0)
ax.set_ylim(4,18.5); ax.set_xlim(start,end)
ax.set_ylabel("identities to AraR consensus (max 16)"); ax.set_xlabel("position on NC_000964.3")
ax.set_title("AraR operator consensus scan across the B. subtilis araABDLMNPQ-abfA operon (araM in red)",fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
